name: northwind
description: Sample trading company (1996-1998): customers, orders, order lines, products, categories, suppliers, employees, shippers.
notes: Revenue of an order line = UnitPrice * Quantity * (1 - Discount) from [Order Details]; order revenue = SUM over its lines.
Order dates are in Orders.OrderDate; filter a year with YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 1997.
Customer names are Customers.CompanyName; employee names are FirstName + ' ' + LastName.

name: pubs
description: Book publisher: titles, authors (linked to titles through titleauthor), publishers, stores, sales, employees.
notes: Authors and titles are many-to-many: join authors -> titleauthor -> titles.
Units sold are sales.qty; a title's price is titles.price; sales revenue = qty * price.
